text:
maya: Quick mock uploaded — https://redwood.design/files/model-catalog-v3.png. Thoughts on filters & compare table?

antoine: Looks great overall. Couple of high-level suggestions: make the compare table collapsible by default, and keep the filter bar sticky as you scroll.

sarah: Agree on sticky filters. Also we should let users pin a model version from the row itself (not buried in a dropdown). e.g., a small pin icon at the right.

alex: +1 for row-level pin. But we need to show pinned version state clearly — maybe a left-side chip with model name + version + a subtle badge for quantization/opt.

kevin: On performance badges: current green/yellow/red is fine but contrast fails some WCAG checks. Suggest we use text + icon (e.g., ⚡ P50: 34ms) instead of color-only.

julia: For filters, can we add a cost slider and quick toggles for "quantized only" and "GPU compatible"? Also add a saved filters dropdown.

maya: Good calls. Specific ask from PM: compare table columns should include p50, p95, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, and memory footprint. We tried to keep it compact. Thoughts on truncation vs horizontal scroll?

antoine: Prefer responsive columns with an overflow menu for less-used metrics (e.g., memory footprint). Horizontal scroll is OK on desktop but bad on mobile. Collapsible/vertical stacking on narrow screens.

sarah: Accessibility nit: table headers need aria-sort and aria-labels for each metric. Also keyboard support: allow arrow keys to move focus across rows and Enter to open compare details.

alex: Copy tweak: the CTA currently says "Pin version" — maybe "Lock serving version" is clearer for enterprise users. But "Pin" is shorter for regular users. Could be contextual.

kevin: UX for version pinning: what about a lightweight modal that confirms the pin and lists ramifications (rollout, fallback policy, traffic split). But don't force modal for quick pins; use a small inline confirmation toast with an "undo" action.

maya: Good compromise: inline toast + link to detailed modal for advanced options. Also need a visual distinction between "pinned for route" vs "pinned globally". Add a tooltip.

julia: Design question: compare table row height is 56px now. If we add more badges it's going to cram. Could we switch to two-line rows when there are badges? Keeps density and avoids horizontal overflow.

antoine: Two-line rows are fine. Also we should make badges interactive: hover reveals exact numbers and a sparkline. For keyboard users, focus should reveal the same info in a panel.

designbot: Reminder: use tokenization alignment component from /design-system/tokens. Badges should re-use existing status tokens (info/warning/error) and include accessible name attributes.

maya: Copy suggestions for badges (short list): "Lat (p50)", "Lat (p95)", "T/s", "Cost/1k", "Quant". Expand full labels on hover.

kevin: One more thing: sorting by composite metrics — allow custom weighted sort so users can prioritize latency vs cost. Maybe a small "Sort by" -> "Latency (weight)" dialog.

alex: Implementation note: the backend already exposes p50/p95 and cost estimates in the model catalog API (v2). We should confirm fields align to front-end names before locking the table. @maya can you make a swagger link?

maya: Yup — linking the API: https://api.redwood.ai/docs/catalog/v2. Also I'll add a dev-ready spec for the compare table.

sarah: Visual/accessibility nit: the pin icon on low-contrast backgrounds disappears. Add a 1px outline or fill state to ensure visibility.

julia: For mobile, consider a "Compare" flow that opens a stacked modal rather than a cramped table. Users can select up to 3 models and compare key metrics vertically.

antoine: Nice. That also maps well to shareable compare links (deep link state). Make sure we support query params for pinned versions.

maya: Action items I'm taking: 1) update mock with sticky filter bar + row pin, 2) swap color-only badges for icon+text, 3) two-line row variant + hover sparkline, 4) add aria attributes and keyboard nav spec, 5) add saved filters UI.

alex: Thanks — please flag if any API fields are missing. I'll review once the spec is up.

sarah: Will follow up with accessibility checklist and a quick screen reader pass.

kevin: :thumbsup:

julia: :eyes: Once mock is updated I'll do a brief Figma review.

maya: Updated mock uploaded to the same link — added pin microcopy variants. Ping me if you want real-time walkthrough 2pm PT.

designbot: Deploy note: new component tokens used in mock are not in prod. Open PR against design-system before dev work.

antoine: Thanks everyone — this is actionable. I'll add the UX tickets and tag the eng owners.

maya: Thanks all!"
